Readings of G24 stated while ruling P14's restrict lines (they apply G24's 'the act or the stance must be stated', not amendments; checked backwards over P14's instantiate files, where no accepted line rests on a proposal alone): (1) Proposals. A proposal or request for machine hands the room does not yet hold ('someone should mod that bot', 'you better write a script', 'if someone rewrites one I will run it', 'we need more bots than them'), with no member writing, sharing, adapting or running one and no stance on their fairness, is not P14's act, so the line is an evidence limit. A member who shares, writes or adapts a script, or puts their own spare accounts to the work ('Time to bring out the alts', 'I have two throwaways I can use'), shows P14 whether or not placements are verified, since the record holds words, not placements. (2) Workarounds that do not place. A glitch or timer trick the room finds does not place (local display only, not registered, vanished on refresh) adds no placement; it is an evidence limit unless members argue over machine hands. A tracker script that places nothing is not machine hands. (3) Stances against reports. Calling others' scripts cheating, unfair or no fun is a stance on machine hands, so P14's argument; a report that another group's bots or alternate accounts damaged the work, or a suspicion that bots are at work, is not
